name: AISmart Content Commerce
author: aismartcontent

sections.description:
AISmart Content Commerce is a companion extension for AISmart Content Chat and WooCommerce. It reuses your site’s existing AISmart Content Chat installation connection to provide storefront product cards, catalog synchronization, order status context, and cart recovery workflows without adding a second chat widget.

Key features:

  • Opt-in Commerce Sync: Catalog synchronization, order context sync, cart recovery snapshots, remote publication, and remote catalog management are all disabled by default on fresh installations until enabled by a store manager.
  • Storefront Cart Bridge: Lets customers view cart contents and add available simple or variable products directly from chat conversations using native WooCommerce validation.
  • Catalog Synchronization: Sends paged product and variation metadata (titles, prices, stock status, categories, and full-resolution gallery image URLs) to your connected AISmart Content workspace when enabled.
  • Order & Cart Recovery Context: Optionally shares order updates and active cart snapshots with your AISmart Content workspace so support and recovery automations have accurate context.
  • Verified Remote Management: Optional store-manager-approved remote publication and catalog management with signed command verification, product locks, and idempotent operation receipts.

External Services

This plugin connects to the AISmartContent Chat Service (https://telewhats.com) operated by AISmartContent.co,ltd through the authenticated AISmart Content Chat installation connection:

  1. Catalog Synchronization & Management (https://telewhats.com/api/integrations/webchat/wordpress/commerce/catalog, /products, /catalog/verify, /publication/verify):
    When enabled by a store manager, the plugin sends store URL, currency, product and variation IDs, SKUs, names, prices, stock quantities/statuses, permalinks, categories/tags/brands, and image URLs to the service, and verifies signed catalog or publication commands issued from the connected workspace.
  2. Order Context Synchronization (https://telewhats.com/api/integrations/webchat/wordpress/commerce/order):
    When Orders & conversations is enabled, order creation and status changes send the site URL, order ID/number, status, total, currency, billing customer name and email, admin order URL, and line item summaries to the service.
  3. Cart Recovery & Storefront Shopper Context (https://telewhats.com/api/integrations/webchat/wordpress/commerce/cart, /shopper-context):
    When Cart recovery is enabled or a shopper interacts with the connected chat widget, the plugin sends cart hash/session token, cart totals, currency, checkout URL, item summaries, and (for signed-in customers or checkout sessions) customer name, billing email, and up to five recent order summaries to the service.
  • AISmartContent Chat Service: https://telewhats.com
  • Service Privacy Policy: https://telewhats.com/privacy
  • AISmartContent Privacy Policy: https://aismartcontent.co/privacy-policy
  • Terms of Service: https://aismartcontent.co/terms
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce and AISmart Content Chat, then connect AISmart Content Chat to your workspace.
  2. Upload the aismart-content-commerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the plugin ZIP through the WordPress admin.
  3. Activate AISmart Content Commerce in the Plugins menu.
  4. Open WooCommerce > AISmart Content Commerce and enable the synchronization features (Catalog synchronization, Orders & conversations, Cart recovery, Remote publication, or Remote catalog management) that your store requires.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin send store or customer data immediately upon activation?

No. All synchronization settings (catalog_sync, order_sync, cart_recovery, remote_publication, and remote_catalog_management) default to false on fresh installations until a store manager enables them and connects AISmart Content Chat.

Does this plugin add a second chat widget to my storefront?

No. It uses the single storefront widget provided by AISmart Content Chat.
sections.changelog:
1.5.0

  • Renamed to AISmart Content Commerce to match AISmart Content Chat. Settings from the earlier build move to the new name automatically on activation.

1.4.0

  • Add optional remote catalog management through the existing signed installation connection, disabled by default.
  • Edit supported product fields and variants, reconcile downloaded image identities, and move confirmed source deletions to Trash.
  • Create explicitly selected cross-platform copies as drafts; publication remains a separate approval and action.
  • Keep durable operation receipts and database product locks for retry-safe writes and draft exports.
  • Preserve managed-export provenance so destination copies cannot be reimported as duplicate native products.

1.3.0

  • Share the current WooCommerce cart with its signed chat session through the installed connection.
  • Add recommended products using WooCommerce stock, option, quantity, and cart validation.
  • Supply up to five recent orders only for the signed-in store customer when order sync is enabled. Guest-supplied email addresses never select order history.

1.2.0

  • Add store-manager-approved remote publication, disabled by default, through the existing installed chat connection.
  • Verify short-lived, installation-bound commands before changing product status and reject repeated commands.
  • Export explicit source publication independently of ShoppungPung publication and catalog sync preferences.

1.1.1

  • Export complete featured and gallery image lists at full resolution, including variation images.
  • Keep source image order and send the complete gallery through the existing ShoppungPung catalog connection.

1.1.0

  • Complete paged product metadata and variant snapshots, refreshed on product changes and daily.
  • Seller-scoped ShoppungPung import status and CF Live eligibility in the native WooCommerce product list.
  • Shopify connection status is separate from product synchronization; products are not automatically copied between stores.
